=== backend lockfiles ===
=== any maven.pkg.github or swcodeGprKey anywhere in backend ===
/workspace/backend/README.md:26:property `swcodeGprKey`. The access token is required to build the project, because it needs to pull packages from
/workspace/backend/README.md:31:   Alternatively, place your `swcodeGprKey=ghp_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx`
=== gradle.properties files ===
/workspace/backend/gradle.properties
(no token props in backend/gradle.properties)

observation.command:
echo "=== backend lockfiles ==="; find /workspace/backend -name "*.lockfile" 2>/dev/null | head; find /workspace/backend -name "gradle.lockfile" -o -name "*.gradle.lockfile" 2>/dev/null | head
echo "=== any maven.pkg.github or swcodeGprKey anywhere in backend ==="; grep -rn "maven.pkg.github\|swcodeGprKey\|packages\.github" /workspace/backend 2>/dev/null | grep -v "\.git/" | head
echo "=== gradle.properties files ==="; find /workspace/backend -name "gradle.properties" -maxdepth 3 2>/dev/null | head; cat /workspace/backend/gradle.properties 2>/dev/null | grep -i "gpr\|token\|github" || echo "(no token props in backend/gradle.properties)"
